thread.title: AAPL likely to repatriate $200B foreign cash, says GBH, adding predictable Netflix speculation

author: Anon
title: AAPL likely to repatriate $200B foreign cash, says GBH, adding predictable Netflix speculation
text:
Home » AAPL likely to repatriate $200B foreign cash, says GBH, adding predictable Netflix speculation AAPL likely to repatriate $200B foreign cash, says GBH, adding predictable Netflix speculation 4 January 2018 Anon 
A GBH research note seen by us predicts that Apple is likely to take advantage of the tax break on repatriated overseas cash to bring back around $200B of its $252B foreign cash hoard. The firm says the company is likely to spend the cash in three ways
